verdict.rationale: Unreal Engine is a platform/tool (not an agent), so the MCP-server axis fairly applies, but evidence shows no official Epic-maintained MCP server exists (GitHub search for `mcp org:EpicGames` returns 0 results) and the most popular community MCP integration is unmaintained since 2025, meaning there's no first-party way to plug MCP servers into Unreal for tool use.
